attacks.name: Eerie Light
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Acidic Poison
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and Burned.

abilities.name: Primal Vibes
abilities.effect: As long as Cradily ex is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play a Pokémon from his or her hand to evolve his or her Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lifesplosion
attacks.effect: For each Energy attached to this Pokémon, search your deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Drain Down
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 30 damage to the new Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon would be Knocked Out by this attack, you may remove all damage counters from Cradily.

attacks.name: Acid
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Devolution Wave
attacks.effect: Count the number of React Energy cards attached to Cradily and choose up to that number of your opponent's Evolved Pokémon. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon, then have your opponent shuffle those cards into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Harsh Fluid
attacks.effect: Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Evolutionary Call
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play Cradily from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards. Show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lure Poison
attacks.effect: Before using this effect, you may switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, if any. The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.effect: Remove 2 damage counters from Cradily (remove 1 if there is only 1).

abilities.name: Super Suction Cups
abilities.effect: As long as Cradily is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Swaying Strangle
abilities.effect: Your opponent’s Pokémon that are affected by Special Conditions can’t retreat.

attacks.name: Miasma Wind
attacks.effect: This attack does 100 damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Selective Slime
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose Burned, Confused, or Poisoned. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.
